title: Positive Depth Target Space Uniqueness
body_html:
Positive Depth Target Space Uniqueness

For a single positive-depth block, the self-dual target lattice functions \(L'\) for which \[ (\Gamma+\mathbf g_{x,r+})\cap M((L\otimes L')_s) \] is nonempty form one \(G'\)-orbit. The target hermitian spaces \(V'\) admitting such a vector are all isometric to \(V_\Gamma\).
proof_html: This combines the positive-depth target hermitian-space uniqueness supercuspidal_theta.positive_depth_target_hermitian_space_uniqueness and the positive-depth target lattice orbit supercuspidal_theta.positive_depth_target_lattice_orbit. The former identifies the only possible target hermitian space as \(V_\Gamma\). Once the target space is fixed, the latter says that all target self-dual lattice functions satisfying the moment-map condition lie in one \(G'\)-orbit.
